summary: PHASE 6 FINAL REGRESSION — FULL PASS. Tested the structural extraction of ResultsSection.jsx (live results card) and HistoricalReportView.jsx (fullscreen overlay) on /dashboard as admin (adrian@affilitube.com). Logged in, topped up draft_credits from 38 to 88. Initial state had 9 pre-existing channel rows (no new search needed). LIVE RESULTS: all 7 filter controls (score-input, affiliate-checkbox, platform-links-checkbox, outreach-select, engagement-select, sort-by-select, sort-order-select) correctly re-rendered the table (score=50 → 4 rows; affiliate-on → 0; engagement=Healthy → 1; etc.). Row click opened ChannelDetailSheet. Shortlist toggle increments/decrements the 'Shortlist: N' header counter correctly (1→2→1, pre-existing Stacia Loo shortlist preserved). export-shortlist-btn clicked without error. re-enrich-btn visible & enabled, tooltip text reads 'Re-enrich with different Advanced Settings (no new search needed)' as expected. SAVE REPORT: dialog opened, filled name 'Phase 6 Regression Report', confirm-save-report-btn clicked, success toast 'Report saved successfully' appeared, dialog closed, History badge incremented to 1, and GET /api/search-reports confirmed the new report. HISTORICAL REPORT VIEW (the critical never-before-tested path): opened History dialog → Reports tab → clicked eye icon on the saved card → fullscreen [data-testid='report-view'] overlay opened with correct header 'Phase 6 Regression Report' and 15 channels. Info card rendered: Total Channels=15, Keywords Used=0 (see minor note), Subscriber Range '2,000 - 100,000', Shortlisted=1. Report filter bar (uses report-* prefixed test-ids, state separate from live) functioned: score=50 → 5 rows, affiliate-on → 0, engagement=Healthy → 4, sort by Affiliate Score + sort order toggled. Row click on first report-row opened ChannelDetailSheet (SAAS Gardens) with all sub-sections (Score Breakdown, Outreach Tracking, Affiliate Potential, Statistics) rendered; after Escape-close the [data-testid='report-view'] WAS STILL VISIBLE behind it (critical state-preservation check PASSED). export-report-btn clicked without error. close-report-btn (Back) cleanly closed the overlay; LIVE dashboard fully interactive with score-input still '0' and 9 rows (STATE ISOLATION VERIFIED — live filters not touched by report filters). Re-opening the report a second time presented Min Score reset to '0' (filter state resets on each open, NOT persisted). Cleanup delete via Trash2 in history dialog succeeded — GET /api/search-reports returned {reports: []}. ZERO console.error events and ZERO pageerror events across the entire ~3-minute multi-screen flow. No regressions detected; refactor is clean.

minor.issue: Report-view info card shows 'Keywords Used: 0' and an empty Keywords chip list even though the source search was the SaaS Tool Reviewers template with non-empty keywords. Likely the saved-report payload is missing the keywords array, or HistoricalReportView reads it from a field the backend isn't populating on save. Not a Phase 6 refactor regression (refactor was pure extraction) — pre-existing data shape issue.

action_items: (Optional, not a regression) Investigate why 'Keywords Used: 0' and empty keyword badges show in the saved-report info card despite the source search having keywords. Check the POST /api/search-reports payload shape and the HistoricalReportView keywords field mapping.
critical_code_review_comments: Naming consistency: HistoricalReportView uses report-filter-* / report-row-* / report-sort-*-select test-ids while ResultsSection uses filter-* / channel-row-* / sort-*-select. The review request expected the same selectors for both — actual implementation correctly disambiguates them, but the divergence should be documented so future tests don't confuse them.
Backend route is /api/search-reports — the review request referenced /api/saved-reports (likely a typo in the spec, not the code). Verified the real route works end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 14 review sub-checks passed, 0 console errors, 0 page errors)
